task_definition.task_description: Please find me a good alternative in the audio category for the Sony XM5 headphones, then add the best recommendation to my cart with a quantity of 2. After that, check my available coupons, apply the best discount for those two items, generate a Stripe payment invoice for $718.20 and send it to customer@example.com, then back up the order workspace as invoice_backup_march, and finally tell me the current local time in New York.
